name: Self Denial
overview: The Scriptures reveal self-denial as a willing and resolute commitment to God's will, exemplified by Abraham's readiness to obey God's command to offer his son Isaac, demonstrating trust and surrender even in difficult circumstances. This passage also illustrates the principle of yielding personal preference for the sake of peace and unity, as Abraham offered Lot the choice of the land, choosing to separate himself rather than contend. Together, these verses show that self-denial involves both a relinquishing of personal rights and a faithful obedience to God's leading.
